page.title: Settings
page.description: Thresholds behind every label on the dashboards

overrides.title: Per-category values
overrides.description: Each COPC category follows the bands above until you switch on Custom.

qa.incidentsDescription: What counts as a low QA score when listing calls.
qa.lowScoreIncident: A call is an incident when its QA score is below
qa.scoreBandsDescription: Applies to the average QA score shown on the Quality Assurance card and the campaign QA column.

compliance.bandsDescription: Compliant at or above On target, Warning at or above Watch, Violation below it. Applies to each area's percentage of passing calls.
compliance.targetDescription: The card's percentage counts the calls that pass this target.
compliance.areaTargetPerCall: An area passes on a call when its score is at or above

sentiment.scaleDescription: Where each band ends on the 1–5 scale.
sentiment.incidentsDescription: What counts as a sentiment incident when listing calls.
sentiment.lowSentimentIncident: A call is an incident when its sentiment is below
sentiment.emotionsDescription: Choose which emotions belong to each sentiment type. Very negative and Negative emotions are the ones counted as negative on the dashboards.
sentiment.emotionsHint: An emotion belongs to one type: adding it to a box removes it from the others. Type a new name and press Enter to add an emotion; it only counts on calls where the analysis detects it.

causes.title: Root causes of sentiment drops
causes.description: Choose which root causes your operation uses and what it calls them, and set when a drop counts as strong. Descriptions for the AI and new causes are managed by the administrator.
causes.strongDrop: A drop is strong when it loses at least
causes.strongDropHint: From this value the drop badge turns red on the call detail.
causes.offHint: A cause that is switched off is no longer offered when correcting a call or in the filters. Calls that already have it keep it. An empty name falls back to the original name.
causes.invalid: Keep at least one cause on.

business.bandsDescription: Shown as a label next to the conversion rate.
business.signalsDescription: A signal is flagged on the card when its share of calls reaches this value.

coaching.groupsDescription: Where the weekly coaching scorecard (0–100) splits into Excellent, Good, Needs improvement and Critical.

usedBy.agents: Coaching → Agents: the group squares and their detail pages.
usedBy.batch: Weekly coaching batch: Critical and Needs improvement get a 1:1; a Good agent who declined too.
usedBy.tenure: Agent coaching profile: the time an agent has spent in their current group.

validation.tierCutsOrder: Excellent must be higher than Good, and Good higher than Needs improvement
validation.bandsOrder: On target must be higher than Watch
validation.cutPointsOrder: Each band must end higher than the one before

copc.title: COPC categories
copc.description: ECN, ENC, ECC and ECUF are measured individually. Set when each one is On target or Watch, as the % of calls without that error.

burnout.signalsDescription: What the voice analysis reads on each call. A signal is active when it passes its limit or drifts from the agent's own baseline by more than the deviation. How much each signal counts is set by the system, in line with its confidence.
burnout.contextNote: Consecutive working days with negative sentiment or emotion in the agent. Days when customers were hostile are left out, so a hard day does not count against the agent.

lexicon.title: Word lists
lexicon.description: What counts as negative language, apathy or empathy in what the agent says, and what a short reply is. Matching ignores case and accents, and only the agent's side is read.
lexicon.statNote: Team figures from the voice analysis of {{count}} calls in the last 30 days
lexicon.placeholder: Type a phrase and press Enter
lexicon.shortDescription: A reply of few words counts as short unless it is on the exceptions list.
lexicon.maxWords: A short reply has up to
lexicon.exceptionsHint: Greetings, thanks and mandatory legal notices never count as short.
lexicon.testPlaceholder: Type something an agent might say
lexicon.testExcepted: A short reply, but it is on the exceptions list.
lexicon.testShort_one: Counts as a short reply ({{count}} word).
lexicon.testShort_other: Counts as a short reply ({{count}} words).

burnout.baselineDescription: Each agent is compared with their own usual level, so someone who always speaks slowly is not flagged. The window sets how many recent days each signal is read over.
burnout.scoreDescription: Active signals add their weight to the score. Sustained days raise it, and active signals in three families add a bonus.
burnout.scoreHint: An agent with fewer than {{count}} active signals stays Low whatever the score.

preview.title: What this would look like
preview.description: The team scored with the values above, before you save.
preview.none: No agent would be at risk with this configuration.

masking.title: Masking
masking.description: Sensitive data is hidden wherever a call is shown: transcripts, evidence quotes, moments, coaching and disputes. The analysis still runs on the full text.

payment.label: Cards and bank accounts
payment.description: Card numbers, CVV, expiry dates, IBAN and account numbers.

identity.label: Identity documents
identity.description: National IDs, social security numbers and passports.

contact.label: Contact and location
contact.description: Phone numbers, email addresses and street addresses.

credentials.label: Credentials and personal data
credentials.description: PINs, passwords, one-time codes and dates of birth.

recording.title: Recording
recording.description: What happens to the audio while the data is said.
recording.muteAudio: Mute the recording while sensitive data is said
recording.screen: Screen recordings follow the same rule: the field is blurred while the data is on screen.

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.description: A QA manager or super admin can see the real data on the call detail for a short time, with a reason that is logged.
reveal.allowed: Allow revealing on the call detail
reveal.requireNote: Require a note besides the reason
reveal.who: Supervisors and agents never see the real data. Coaching and disputes always show it masked.

test.title: Try a sentence
test.none: Nothing in this sentence would be masked.

log.title: Reveal log
log.description: Every time the real data was shown, by whom and why.

errors.revealMinutes: The reveal time must be between 5 and 120 minutes.
errors.showLast: Visible digits must be between 0 and 4.
